svg.title: Developmental lineage tree of germ-layer hypervariability categories
svg.desc: A phylogeny-style tree: a systemic pre-gastrulation trunk carrying the allLayers category splits at gastrulation into endoderm, mesoderm and ectoderm branches ending in the three layer-specific categories.

g.text: Systemic: hypervariable (hv) across all three layers; set before gastrulation (ME candidate)

text.tspan: stable (hypervariability score < median) in the other two
